title: Precision preset intake and drift sentinel for quantized model onboarding
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Establish a reproducible intake and certification pipeline for "precision presets" (quantization artifacts and profile metadata) and a lightweight Drift Sentinel that detects perf regressions for INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ variants during onboarding and subsequent published profile updates. This ticket covers the engine-side validation harness, CI gates, artifact metadata schema extensions, and an automated canary job that runs representative prompts to surface latency/cost/quality regressions before a profile is published or pinned.
acceptance_criteria: A schema for precision presets is defined and documented (weights variant, quant backend, calibration seed, op exceptions, expected throughput/loss ranges).
An automated CI job validates a new preset against a canonical eval set and publishes a per-preserve artifact with numeric metrics (latency p50/p95, token cost, quality delta) to the registry.

A Drift Sentinel job exists that re-runs a selected subset of the canonical eval weekly and flags >5% regressions in quality or >25% increases in median latency compared to the pinned baseline. Alerts create a follow-up issue automatically.
Canary deployment flow is added to the console: onboarding -> staged-canary -> pin or rollback, with visible metrics for each stage.
Integrations: GitHub PR must include the preset artifact reference; Console shows the preset's performance snapshot and a link to the regression report.
onboarding_flow: Developer uploads model artifact + candidate precision presets (INT8/GPTQ/AWQ/FP8) via intake API or upload UI.
CI runner performs deterministic calibration + small-batch correctness checks (soft-fp baseline comparisons).
Validation harness measures throughput and latency on representative hardware targets and emits normalized metrics.
Precision preset metadata is enriched with fingerprint, compatibility matrix (sequence lengths/hw), and fallback recommendations.
If metrics are within acceptance ranges, preset is placed in staged-canary. Otherwise it fails with diagnostics collected.
regression_detection_strategy: Baseline pinning: every published preset is pinned to a baseline commit + metric snapshot in the registry.
Periodic re-eval: Drift Sentinel replays a terse prompt set (stratified by length and modality) weekly and compares quality/latency to baseline using predefined thresholds.
Multi-metric alerting: trigger if any of: quality delta (EM/F1/LL) > 5%, median latency regression > 25%, token cost increase > 20%.
Triaging rules: auto-open ENG issue with failing metric details; annotate with likely root cause (kernel mismatch, calibration seed drift, hardware variance).
Fallback automation: for high-severity regressions, automatically set traffic routing to the prior pinned variant for dedicated customers until manual review.
